featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

today.name: EXPORT OF NORDIC SALMONS TO THE EUROPE!
today.description:
## EXPORT OF NORDIC SALMONS TO THE EUROPE! 🐟
- Export severských lososů do srdce Evropy!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/WNPDcQ8.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for the Salmon Fillet.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Bergen.
*  **19:00**  - Departure from Bergen to Oslo Highway.
*  **19:15**- Passage trough wonderful Bergen Tunnels.
*  **19:25** - Passage around the city of Oslo.
*  **19:50** - Arrival to the pause near Helsingborg.
*  **20:00** - Departure from the pause near Helsingborg.
*  **20:15** - Crossing over The Øresund Bridge - Denmark.
*  **20:25** - Denmark // Germany border.
*  **20:35** - Passage around the city of Hamburg.
*  **21:00** - Arrival to the city of Duisburg and final photo.


![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/EODxGdP.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Bergen, Industrial Area - Duisburg, Container Port.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL SLOTS - BERGEN INDUSTRIAL ZONE:

![](https://i.imgur.com/aSOxC7M.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)


[![](https://i.imgur.com/c0lnezn.png)](https://trucksbook.eu/company/176895)

now.name: A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION
now.description:
# **A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION**
![](https://i.postimg.cc/bNnzfPXr/02b296bb-c3b1-4921-bf72-a0b9761ddb47.png)

GTLEGION VTC invites you to a special Halloween-themed convoy where the road becomes the beginning of a nightmare.

This October, GTLEGION VTC invites drivers to leave the ordinary roads behind and enter a darker world filled with mysterious nights, Halloween atmosphere, glowing pumpkins, foggy roads and the feeling that something may be waiting around the next corner.

Inspired by the atmosphere of classic horror cinema and the nightmare concept of A Nightmare on Elm Street, this convoy combines the spirit of Halloween with the freedom of the open road.

But remember:

 Some nightmares should stay in the night.*




> “One, two, Freddy's coming for you.
> Three, four, better lock your door.
> Five, six, grab your crucifix.
> Seven, eight, gonna stay up late.
> Nine, ten, never sleep again.”


-----

![](https://i.postimg.cc/j5vdy6yP/convoy-route.gif)
### 🛣️ **THE ROUTE**

Our journey will begin in Bern, Switzerland
![](https://i.postimg.cc/X7sgWRw0/Route.png)

**Expect:**

* 
* 🌲 Dark forests and atmospheric roads
* 🌙 Night-time scenery
* 🏔️ Mountain landscapes
* 🌉 Scenic viewpoints
* 🛣️ Interesting and varied roads
* 📸 Multiple opportunities for screenshots and photography
* 🎃 A Halloween atmosphere throughout the journey



-----
### 🎃 **THE HALLOWEEN ATMOSPHERE**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/mgx7TTPB/ae0b475d7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

This is not a traditional Halloween party.

The entire convoy will be built around a darker horror atmosphere.

**Expect:**

* 🎃 Pumpkins
* 🌕 Moonlit roads
* 🌫️ Fog and darkness
* 🦇 Halloween decorations
* 🧤 Nightmare-inspired elements
* 🔪 Horror-style visuals
* 🚛 Specially prepared convoy vehicles
* 🌙 A night-time atmosphere



-----

🎥 **EVENT MEDIA**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/V6Hbp8xR/7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

The convoy will also receive dedicated media coverage.

Our media team will capture the most atmospheric moments of the journey, including:

* 📸 Event photography
* 🎥 Convoy footage
* 📺 Video content
* ▶️ Short clips
* 🌙 Night-time shots
* 🚛 Group formations
* 🎃 Halloween-themed screenshots
* ⭐ Event highlights

Selected moments from the convoy may later be used for GTLEGION media content and event highlights.



-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/NjSfrk3k/8ad7-8db93eb9d09a.png)
-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/4ymZtDJb/convoycontrolstrobe.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/fTVDVB3R/Event-Supervised-By.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/pdqgZsc0/media.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/sXZVfCBn/1d537353-d484-4a38-81c1-3a2f6840dfd3.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/0ygxMXhG/real-ops.gif)

# 🚛・𝐇𝐅𝐃 𝐓𝐑𝐔𝐂𝐊 𝐌𝐄𝐄𝐓

Willkommen zum **HFD Truck Meet** von **Heavy Freight Logistik (HFD)!** 🔥

Wir treffen uns gemeinsam auf **Simulation 2** zu einem entspannten Truck Meet mit anschließender gemeinsamer Konvoifahrt. Egal ob du mit deinem schönsten Truck zum Treffen kommst oder einfach Teil der Community sein möchtest – jeder ist willkommen!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 📅・Event-Informationen

📆 **Datum:** Samstag, 17.10.2026
🕖 **Treffpunkt:** 19:00 Uhr
🕢 **Start der Konvoifahrt:** 19:00 Uhr
🎮 **Spiel:** Euro Truck Simulator 2
🌍 **Server:** Simulation 2
📍 **Start:** Hannover – Sanbuilders
🏁 **Ziel:** Kiel – PolarisLines
🚛 **Event-Typ:** Truckfest & Convoy

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🚚・Was erwartet euch?

🔹 Gemeinsames Truck Meet mit der HFD-Community
🔹 Präsentiert eure Trucks und Designs
🔹 Macht gemeinsam Screenshots und Erinnerungsbilder
🔹 Anschließende Konvoifahrt von Hannover nach Kiel
🔹 Spaß, nette Leute und eine entspannte Atmosphäre

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🔥・Seid dabei!

Packt eure besten Trucks aus, tankt voll und seid pünktlich am Treffpunkt!

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Fahrer, der dabei ist und gemeinsam mit uns einen geilen Abend auf der Straße verbringen möchte. ❤️

**Euer Team von Heavy Freight Logistik (HFD)** 🚛
upcoming.rule:

⚠️ Haltet euch an die TruckersMP-Regeln.
🚫 Kein Rammen, Blockieren oder absichtliches Behindern anderer Fahrer.
🤝 Behandelt alle Teilnehmer respektvoll.

upcoming.name: From Moravia to the Baltic
upcoming.description:
## Pridružite nam se na uzbudljivoj ruti koja spaja srce Češke Republike sa istorijskim lučkim gradom na Baltičkom moru! Polazimo iz slikovitog Brna, drugog po veličini češkog grada, i vozimo se pravo na sever kroz živopisne pejzaže Poljske. Naš krajnji cilj je Gdanjsk, prelepa baltička luka poznata po svojoj bogatoj istoriji i arhitekturi.

## English:
## 
## Join us on an exciting route that connects the heart of the Czech Republic with a historic port city on the Baltic Sea! We depart from picturesque Brno, the second largest Czech city, and drive straight north through the picturesque landscapes of Poland. Our final destination is Gdansk, a beautiful Baltic port known for its rich history and architecture.
## 
##  Očekuje nas duga i dinamična vožnja koja zahteva maksimalnu koncentraciju, održavanje bezbednog rastojanja i poštovanje saobraćajnih propisa u okviru Convoy režima. Pripremite svoje kamione, napunite rezervoare i osigurajte teret za ovu fantastičnu evropsku rutu!

## English:
## 
## We are expecting a long and dynamic ride that requires maximum concentration, maintaining a safe distance and observing traffic regulations within the Convoy mode. Prepare your trucks, fill the tanks and secure the cargo for this fantastic European route!

upcoming.description:
# 🚛 🎗️ **TCCR Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her**  



## 🎗️ ABOUT THE EVENT  

This is not just a convoy.  

This October, TCCR invites you to be part of something meaningful —  
**“Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her”**  

A charity event dedicated to the fight against breast cancer,  
and a personal tribute that makes this convoy truly special.
  
This event is held **in honor of a mother** —  
a symbol of strength, love, and resilience.  

Through her story, we stand with every woman  
who has faced, is facing, or will face this battle.
  
💖 Together, we drive with purpose.  

---

## 💰 CHARITY & DONATIONS  

We are raising funds to support the fight against breast cancer.  

🎗️ **How to support:**  
  
* Donate through our official campaign link  https://www.goodcrowd.org/c/baf0jTCR   
* Share the event  
* Join the convoy and be part of the message  

All contributions help bring awareness and support to this cause.  

---

## 🎀 DONATION LEVELS  

💖 **$5 — In Memory**  
🌸 **$10 — Supporter**  
🎗️ **$25 — Pink Warrior**  
👑 **$50 — Legacy**  

Every contribution matters. Every name becomes part of this journey.  


## 🤝 PARTNERS & VTCs  

We welcome all VTCs and communities to be part of this cause.  

If your VTC would like to participate or collaborate,  
feel free to contact us.  

💖 Let’s make this convoy a united effort.  

---

---

## 📌 EVENT INFORMATION  

**📅 Date:** Sunday , October 18, 2026  
**🕒 Meetup Time:** 18:30 UTC  
**🚚 Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC 

**📍 Start Location:** Calais  (Slots)   
**🏁 Destination:** Hamburg (IA Automotive)   
  
**🌍 DLC Required:** none  
**🖥️ Server:** Event Server   

---

## 📸 MEDIA & COVERAGE  

* Official screenshots will be taken  
* Recap will be published after the event  
* Streaming is highly encouraged  


This convoy is more than a route.  

It is a tribute.  
A memory.  
A message of hope.  

🎗️ Join us. Drive with us.  
Drive for her.

upcoming.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants:**

- The Event Staff are recognized as; “Drive Along | EF, Drive Along | ES, Drive Along | CC, Drive Along | Lead, Drive Along | Tail, Drive Along | GM" or similar.
- Free roaming is prohibited.
- Participants must haul a trailer.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

- **Event Rules for Event Staff:**

- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
